description:
### Ekşi Morphe (v0.1.7)

* **Relative entry timestamps**: New patch. Entries younger than 48 hours show their age next to the date, for example "21.11.2026 11:12 · 12 sa 3 dk". Older entries show only the date. You can turn this patch off in Morphe Manager.

Supports Ekşi Sözlük 2.5.1.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes Ekşi Sözlük ad placements and disables ad loading.

patches.name: Open external links in browser
patches.description: Opens external web links in the default browser instead of a Chrome Custom Tab.

patches.name: Relative entry timestamps
patches.description: Shows the age of entries younger than 48 hours next to the entry date, for example "12 sa 3 dk".
